annotation.title_clean: AI Foundation Models: Technical update report
annotation.title_en: AI Foundation Models: Technical update report
named_instruments_referenced: Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Bill
annotation.summary_en: UK Competition and Markets Authority update on AI foundation models, reviewing market developments, stakeholder feedback on its proposed principles (access, diversity, choice, fair dealing, transparency, accountability), and three competition risks. It confirms the principles and outlines next steps, including chip paper and enforcement powers.
key_provisions_or_claims: Confirms CMA's AI principles: access, diversity, choice, fair dealing, transparency, accountability.
Identifies three key risks to fair, open and effective competition in FM markets.
Notes partnerships and incumbent control of inputs may entrench market power.
Anticipates new CMA consumer enforcement powers under the DMCC Bill, with penalties up to 10% of turnover.
Plans AI accelerator chip paper, DRCF research, ICO joint statement, and autumn 2024 update.
